constraints.claim: Otherwise-identical evidence with more pure support must not reduce net-quality score.
Otherwise-identical evidence with more pure pressure must not increase net-quality score.
For a broadly supportive major, Hãm must not raise the support axis relative to Miếu on the same star identity.
Admitted malefic/pressure evidence must remain visible on the pressure axis (not zeroed by diminishing to nothing when it is the sole contributor).
Adding natal Hóa Lộc with positive support seed must not reduce quality versus the same chart without that transform, holding other evidence fixed.
High activation alone must not raise net-quality.
